Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for committing BluePeak to the joint AWS marketplace co-sell demo. We ran a quick availability check on our side and have a couple of suggested windows that align with both the AWS SI and CloudWave schedules. Goal: a 75–90 minute session (overview + 30–45m technical deep dive) to demonstrate Redwood Inference + BluePeak integration and marketplace provisioning flow.

Proposed windows (CET):
- Tue Aug 17: 09:30–11:00 CET
- Wed Aug 18: 10:00–11:30 CET
- Wed Aug 18: 15:00–16:30 CET (falls into APAC-friendly window)

Attachments: co-sell-runbook-v2.pdf (agenda + roles), calendar-conflict-snapshot.png (our current team availability).

If any of the above work, I’ll send calendar invites and share a short runbook in Drive. If Raj (SI lead) needs an earlier APAC-friendly slot, flag which of the three he prefers and we’ll try to split the session.

Thanks — looking forward.

- Wed Aug 18 09:00–09:45 IST (05:30–06:15 CET) — short tech deep dive for APAC only
- Wed Aug 18 15:30–16:30 IST (12:00–13:00 CET) — full session possible if that helps

Thanks — splitting seems sensible to avoid forcing Raj into a terrible timezone. Proposed approach:

1) APAC-focused tech drop-in (30–45m) with Raj leading: Wed Aug 18 05:30–06:15 CET (09:00–09:45 IST) — agenda: topology, deployment steps, marketplace provisioning gotchas.
2) Joint session for EU/US audience (75m): Wed Aug 18 12:00–13:15 CET — agenda: high-level product story, BluePeak customer outcomes, demo of provisioning via AWS marketplace, followed by a 30–45m technical Q&A (Marcus to lead).

Vanessa — can you confirm you and Marcus can cover the 12:00–13:15 CET session? Marcus, if you can’t do the start time exactly, say so and we’ll nudge it by 30m. I’ve attached a snapshot of our calendar conflicts for context.

If everyone approves I’ll: (a) create two calendar invites (APAC tech + joint session), (b) drop a short runbook link in Drive, and (c) add the HubSpot event to DL-7845.

—Jonas
